critical_code_review_comments: server.py:471 — nextReminderAt = expectedAt - timedelta(days=reminderLeadDays) when reminderLeadDays>0. When lead is 0 (or expectedAt is None), it falls back to expectedAt. Behavior matches spec.

server.py:754 — followup-draft returns 402 with detail={'code':'AI_LIMIT','limit':FREE_AI_FOLLOWUPS} for FREE users after 3 uses; test tolerates both 200 and 402 as required. Consider always allowing draft for 0-item cases before the quota check, but items existence is fine.
server.py:786 — /stats/monthly loads up to 5000 awaits per request. Acceptable for FREE plan; consider a Mongo aggregation grouped by ($year,$month) of createdAt / completedAt if user data grows.

MonthlyChart.tsx:36-84 — Pure RN Views/Text; no transformOrigin/CSS-only props leaked. Previous DOM warning is no longer triggered in web preview (confirmed 0 transform-origin warnings across full session).

AwaitForm.tsx:47 — suggested = clamp(round(avgDaysLate||2), 2, 7). For Amazon avgDaysLate=28 the suggested chip is capped at 7 → chip set becomes {0, 7, 10}; matches spec's 'form-lead-7 / form-lead-10 style chips'. Consider surfacing that the cap exists in UX copy.
followup/[id].tsx:145 — followup-draft-input is bound to editable state; when API returns fallback text on LLM failure, UI degrades gracefully. Good.
